title: Customer Service Administrator
description: As Customer Service Administrator you will joining a small, busy service team. The role is based on site in Buckingham, is full time and permanent offering a salary of up to 26,000. Working for a highly successful business who have worked in the garage equipment sector for decades. Purpose of the role: Supporting the service team providing high levels of customer service, maintaining the database and administration. Key Accountabilities of the Customer Service Administrator: - Be first point of contact for customers - Providing high levels of customer care over the phone and via email - Liaise with customers, resolving any queries quickly and efficiently - Generate system based quotes and invoices - Support with coordinating service administration - Contact customers to confirm proposed dates and obtain order numbers for scheduled work - Maintain database all customer records Skills Required for the Service Administrator: - Confident customer services skills - Methodical approach used to managing a busy workload - Administration experience within an office environment - Solid IT skills including MS Office - Excellent communications skills - Organised approach to work, able to work on multiple tasks at the same time - High levels of accuracy and attention to detail - Adaptable in a changing environment What's in it for you? - A salary of up to 26,000 - Monday to Thursday 8.30 am to 5.00 pm with an hour for lunch, Friday 8.30 - 4.30 with 30 min lunch - 22 days hol +bank hols, increasing with service - Training, support and development - Working for a successful, established business - Private healthcare for you and your family after six month probation

title: Customer Care Coordinator
company: A.D.S CONSTRUCTION PERSONNEL LTD - Agency - Permanent
description: Repairs Coordinator / Customer Care Coordinator Milton Keynes £23,000 - £32,000 Full-time, Monday to Friday, 8:00 am - 4:30 pm Hybrid working after training period: 3 days at home and 2 days in the office What's Offered - Hybrid working once settled: 3 days at home and 2 days in the office - Friendly, supportive team with long-standing staff - Guidance from an experienced Contracts Manager - Varied role with responsibility and autonomy - Stable employer with ongoing development opportunities Overview A leading drylining contractor with long-standing staff and a supportive working culture is looking to appoint a Repairs Coordinator / Customer Care Coordinator. The role requires someone with residential experience in a similar customer care or repairs position, confident managing defects, remedial works and patching programmes across occupied properties. A strong personality and confident telephone manner are essential. Key Responsibilities - Manage customer care and repairs defects from initial instruction through to completion - Schedule patchers and operatives across multiple sites and occupied properties - Liaise with site managers, subcontractors, quantity surveyors and homeowners - Coordinate appointments and maintain regular communication with residents - Prepare quotations for remedial and chargeable works - Process variation orders and monitor approval status - Track labour, materials and commercial costs - Maintain and update internal Excel trackers and reporting systems - Produce weekly and monthly performance reports - Monitor workloads and ensure resources are allocated effectively - Order materials and coordinate collections - Manage customer care documentation, photographs and site records - Assist with resolving customer complaints professionally and promptly - Support management with operational and commercial administration Skills and Experience Required - Residential customer care or repairs experience in a similar role - Strong personality with confident telephone manner - Confident using Excel, Outlook and Microsoft Office - High attention to detail and strong organisational skills - Comfortable dealing with site staff, contractors, residents and internal teams
